Interface IMdfFeatureListReferrableExtensions<T extends com.vector.cfg.model.mdf.commoncore.autosar.MIReferrable>

  • All Superinterfaces:
    IMdfFeatureListTypeExtensions<T>
    All Known Subinterfaces:
    IMdfFeatureListSubContainerExtensions

    @PublishedApi(value=ADDITIONS_ALLOWED)
 @PublishedApiDomain(value=AUTOMATION_IF)
public interface IMdfFeatureListReferrableExtensions<T extends com.vector.cfg.model.mdf.commoncore.autosar.MIReferrable>
extends IMdfFeatureListTypeExtensions<T>
    The interface IMdfFeatureListReferrableExtensions defines some method extensions for MDF child lists to create and add new MIReferrable child objects.
